# Test fixtures

`formPropTest.accdb` is from jetdb (https://github.com/dominion525/jetdb, `testdata/`), dual-licensed
under the MIT License or the Apache License 2.0. It holds Access forms used to test importing forms.

`macroTestV2010.accdb` is from the same project and license. It holds named macros (AutoExec,
If / Else If / Else) and an embedded macro on a button, used to test importing macros.
